Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Second Tradition: Domain

Requires a ready prince or justicar.
+2 intercept. Also usable by a tapped prince or justicar, even if intercept is not yet needed, to burn a blood to untap and attempt to block with +2 intercept.

Seduction

Only usable as the acting vampire's action is announced.
[dom] Choose a younger vampire. That vampire cannot block this action.
[DOM] As above, but you may choose a vampire the same age or older.

If a vampire is chosen by Seduction, can its controller play 2nd Tradition, or other wake effect that attempt to block as a part of its effect, to untap, fail to block, then play a reaction like a Deflection or a Telepathic Misdirection ?

Messages.Author: Pendargon
Messages.Body:
No.

You cannot block, so you cannot attempt to block at all

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Pendargon wrote:
> No.
>
> You cannot block, so you cannot attempt to block at all
>
Correct. If you can't attempt to block, you can't play cards that have you attempt to block.  [LSJ 20010714]
